summary: Assess AI capability with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001. Build a scored gap register and practical roadmap. Explore the course.
lede: AI maturity assessment helps governance, risk, technology and business professionals evaluate AI capability using documented evidence and identify gaps. You’ll scope an assessment, build an evidence register, review lifecycle controls, score maturity, rank improvements and present findings in a roadmap, using NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 23894 as reference points.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who assess AI capability, oversee AI-enabled services or need defensible evidence for investment and governance decisions. It is designed for intermediate-level practitioners with some exposure to AI initiatives or organizational risk processes.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to AI projects, AI-enabled services, data governance or organizational risk processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use assessment evidence and Excel-based scoring.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
